generated_for: Simon Anderson Surfboards official named standup catalog

brands.name: Simon Anderson Surfboards
brands.location_label: North Narrabeen, New South Wales, Australia
brands.short_description: Thruster pioneer Simon Anderson — performance shortboards, step-ups, and heritage shapes from North Narrabeen since 1971.

models.name: 5 Spark
models.description: Swallow tail performance fish with Thruster or Quad fin options. Designed to be surfed as a Thruster in 3–4' surf, or Quad in 1–2'. Features a streamlined fish outline, flatter deck, low soft rails, single to double concave, vee through the tail and a smooth medium rocker.

models.name: Alley
models.description: Developed to maximize speed, carve and aerial potential. Generous nose and tail area with rounded square tail, vee deck to low boxy rail, deep single concave throughout, low to mid nose entry with slight flip towards the tip. Medium tail rocker.

models.name: DSC & DSCV
models.description: Step-up or semi-gun rounded pin Thruster, with a Quad option. Designed for speed and life, balanced with control. Rocker is smooth and moderate with slight single to double concave and low soft rail. DSCV is a similar design but has vee in the back half of the board.

models.name: Face Dancer
models.description: A good all-rounder customized over the years to surf up as a semi-gun, or down as a smaller wave performance board for a one board quiver. Quad option, good wave Thruster. Slightly increased area in the nose, normal width in the round tail. Single concave to vee at the tail. Smooth moderate rocker. Low soft rails.

models.name: Mollusc Robo
models.description: A stretched-out version of Mollusc, designed to add paddle power and wave-catching ability while retaining a performance feel. Features streamlined fuller nose, round tail, lower nose entry, medium tail rocker, and a combination of concave and vee through the back half of the board.

models.name: Mollusc
models.description: Designed for all-round surfing as a retro style performance shape in 2–5' surf. A fuller outline performance shortboard with added area through the nose and round tail. Features a single to double concave, low entry rocker, medium tail rocker, and slightly fuller low soft rails.

models.name: NXFC
models.description: Modern high-performance shortboard combining speed, responsiveness, and control. Rounded square tail, balanced nose and tail planshape, single to double concave low soft rails. Fast and loose but predictable at the edge of performance parameters.

models.name: Varmit
models.description: A fuller volume performance board with extra width through the nose and overall plan shape, combined with a rounded square tail, single to double concave and smooth modern rocker. Normal length but wider nose on a wider board with a normal width rounded square.
